How the chained comparison varies with power

Source: R/chain.R
chain_by_level.Rd

The level-wise counterpart to chain_sources(), and on the same rule: a pair that rode together is compared within each power band from its own seconds, and only a pair that never did is chained through the bridge. The bands kept are those every run actually covered, since a gain chained from bands one run never rode is extrapolation rather than measurement.

Usage

chain_by_level(
  aligned,
  bridge = NULL,
  width = 25,
  min_seconds = 30,
  min_power = 0
)

Arguments

aligned

Result of align_rides().

bridge

Source common to more than one run. Found automatically when exactly one source qualifies.

width

Bin width in watts.

min_seconds

Bins with fewer paired seconds than this are dropped.

min_power

Both sources must exceed this to count, in watts.

Value

A tibble with one row per band per source pair, restricted to bands covered by every run involved.

See also

Other chaining: bridge_candidates(), chain_sources()

Examples

read_rides(demo_rides()) |> align_rides() |> chain_by_level()
#> # A tibble: 27 × 4
#>    source_a source_b  band gain_pc
#>    <chr>    <chr>    <dbl>   <dbl>
#>  1 assioma  kickr     87.5    3.20
#>  2 assioma  kickr    112.     2.98
#>  3 assioma  kickr    138.     2.70
#>  4 assioma  kickr    162.     2.37
#>  5 assioma  kickr    188.     2.30
#>  6 assioma  kickr    212.     2.52
#>  7 assioma  kickr    238.     2.86
#>  8 assioma  kickr    262.     2.84
#>  9 assioma  kickr    288.     2.77
#> 10 assioma  quarq     87.5    2.98
#> # ℹ 17 more rows
